entries.name: BThwani Task Discovery
entries.purpose: Progressive remediation discovery: runs the parallel read-only inventory and baseline scripts under tools/remediation/discovery/, rejects any tracked mutation, and uploads the evidence bundle as an artifact. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-B).

entries.name: BThwani Contextual CI
entries.purpose: Root orchestrator: detects affected scope and fans out to the reusable verification workflows with one fail-closed aggregate result.

entries.name: BThwani Policy Verification
entries.purpose: Nomenclature plus governance, workflow, security, and infrastructure policy guards.

entries.name: BThwani Node Diagnostics
entries.purpose: UI purity, dead-code, logic, accessibility, dependency, structure, performance, contract, and diff-hygiene diagnostics.

entries.name: BThwani Node Verification
entries.purpose: Nx typecheck, lint, test, and build over all or affected projects plus journey and platform change-set gates.

entries.name: BThwani Backend Verification
entries.purpose: Dynamic Go backend matrix: applies migrations then runs go test and go build per affected service.

entries.name: BThwani Runtime Proof
entries.purpose: Docker runtime bring-up, bootstrap, smoke, and teardown when runtime proof is required.

entries.name: DSH Database Contract
entries.purpose: Verifies the canonical DSH database path against a PostgreSQL service.

entries.name: JRN-020-025 Sambassam Verification
entries.purpose: Fullstack boundary, WLT financial boundary, and governed route exposure for journeys 020 to 025.

entries.name: BThwani Lockfile Snapshot
entries.purpose: Regenerates a frozen-install-compatible lockfile candidate and uploads it as an artifact; never commits.

entries.name: BThwani Expert Live-Code Remediation
entries.purpose: Manual patch-only remediation: applies deterministic repairs in the runner, verifies them, and exports a signed patch artifact without any privileged write. Modernization is tracked as GAP-0002.
